description: Add concrete steps to a milestone. A step is an action that fits a few work blocks ("email 10 people from the waitlist"), not "do marketing". Abstract steps are rejected. Put a hard-lever step first; preparation only where it blocks it (warns otherwise).

op_id.description: for apps replaying queued requests: an id the app minted before its first attempt and reuses on retries, so the write is applied once and a retry gets the first answer back. Do not invent one; an agent calling interactively leaves it out

name: add_steps
title: Add steps
